fusions.name: Eye of the Gap
fusions.desc: A thrust from the full length of the haft that deals 30 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Stitching Prick
fusions.desc: Drives the tip through the weak seam, dealing 7 damage and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Threaded Sight
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Weak Spot Ledger
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 10% against enemies carrying your afflictions.
